about: The skeleton of the owner's Tripo grasbítur (geymsla/tripo/grasbitur-tripo-v1.glb) for remake/tools/blender-crowd.py: joints in the file's own glTF space (metres as delivered, +Y up, the beak toward -X, its left side +Z), placed from its slices (each leg's cross-section by height, the body's line) and a side render. Its legs stand upright under the body; the right forefoot stands a little ahead of the left, the beak is turned a little to its left and the tail curves gently that way: the rig keeps them so, but each pair of shoulders and hips stands at one x (a body is even), so the gaits are even. The head joint is behind the frill, so the frill turns with the head. rigidFeet: each foot below its ankle moves as one piece (planted soles stay put). headShare: the head's share of each level's triangles, at most (his head is detailed and would take most of them; the legs need the triangles to bend).
